sentences.en: One summer a few years ago, Alex Morrow was visiting friends in Berlin,
sentences.zh: 几年前的一个夏天，亚历克斯·莫罗去柏林探望朋友，

sentences.en: and he made plans to go out to one of the city's most famous techno clubs,
sentences.zh: 他计划去城里最著名的夜店之一玩，

sentences.en: The club is notoriously difficult to get into,
sentences.zh: 这家夜店以极难进入而闻名，

sentences.en: and so Alex made sure he looked just right.
sentences.zh: 所以亚历克斯特意打扮了一番。

sentences.en: They said, like, wear black, so I was wearing everything black,
sentences.zh: 他们说，比如，穿黑色，所以我全身都穿了黑色，

sentences.en: like black t-shirt, black jeans, black socks.
sentences.zh: 比如黑色T恤、黑色牛仔裤、黑色袜子。

sentences.en: I said, you know, just in case, I'll wear black underwear as well.
sentences.zh: 我说，你知道，以防万一，我连内衣也穿黑色的。

sentences.en: Even with the black underwear, Alex didn't think much of his chances,
sentences.zh: 即使穿了黑色内衣，亚历克斯也没觉得有多大把握，

sentences.en: but the doorman waved him through.
sentences.zh: 但门卫还是挥手让他进去了。

sentences.en: And all of a sudden, you're in this environment
sentences.zh: 突然之间，你就置身于这样一个环境，

sentences.en: where the music is penetrating you,
and I was just like, wow.
The club is in a former power plant,
sentences.zh: 这家夜店位于一座前发电厂内，

sentences.en: and it still has that rough and industrial look.
sentences.zh: 它依然保留着那种粗犷的工业风。

sentences.en: There's reporter Kevin Kaners, who lives in Berlin.
sentences.zh: 这是住在柏林的记者凯文·卡纳斯。

sentences.en: It's a huge hall with massively high ceilings and different floors.
sentences.zh: 这是一个巨大的大厅，天花板极高，还有不同的楼层。

sentences.en: And filling the building, of course, is the sound of techno
sentences.zh: 当然，充斥着整栋建筑的是通过巨大的音响墙，

sentences.en: pumped out through an enormous wall of speakers.
It was just the sound, and I just got fully into it.
sentences.zh: 那纯粹是声音的震撼，我完全沉浸其中了。

sentences.en: Alex lives in London, and he'd been clubbing there plenty of times,
sentences.zh: 亚历克斯住在伦敦，他在那里去过很多次夜店，
但这完全是另一种体验。

sentences.en: Everyone can do their thing as long as everyone respects each other.
sentences.zh: 只要大家互相尊重，每个人都可以做自己。

sentences.en: If you see someone naked dancing next to you, cool.
sentences.zh: 如果你看到有人在你旁边裸舞，酷。

sentences.en: If you see someone wearing a suit, cool.
sentences.zh: 如果你看到有人穿着西装，酷。

sentences.en: If people are having sex, okay.
sentences.zh: 如果有人在做爱，没问题。

sentences.en: And I could have done whatever I wanted in that club.
sentences.zh: 在那家夜店里，我可以做任何我想做的事。

sentences.en: But I made my decision to just dance.
14 hours later, Alex was still dancing.
sentences.zh: 14个小时后，亚历克斯还在跳舞。

sentences.en: It was like he'd been put into some kind of trance.
sentences.zh: 就像他进入了某种恍惚状态一样。

sentences.en: And I danced until about 6 in the morning.
sentences.zh: 我一直跳到早上6点左右。

sentences.en: It was a very joyous, introverted experience for me.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，那是一次非常快乐、向内的体验。

sentences.en: Now Alex tries to come back to Berlin every year,
sentences.zh: 现在亚历克斯尽量每年都回柏林，

sentences.zh: 二战结束后，德国被分裂了。

East Berlin was socialist and controlled by the Soviet Union.

sentences.en: West Berlin, on the other hand, was capitaliSt.

sentences.zh: 它是一个民主西德的奇怪岛屿前哨，

sentences.zh: 漂浮在社会主义东德的中心。

sentences.en: Then in 1961, the city became divided not only politically,
sentences.zh: 1961年，这座城市不仅在政治上被分裂，
在物理上也同样被隔绝。

sentences.en: The East German government built a huge wall with checkpoints
sentences.zh: 东德政府修建了一道带有检查站的巨大围墙，

sentences.zh: 以阻止其公民逃往西方。

sentences.en: And soon, divided by a wall,
and living under completely different political and economic systems,

两个截然不同的城市出现了，

sentences.zh: 他在柏林墙建成17年后来到了西柏林。

sentences.en: And he immediately fell in love with this strange, divided city.
sentences.zh: 他立刻爱上了这座奇怪、分裂的城市。

sentences.zh: 我发现这座城市和我去过的任何地方都不一样。

And so eager to attract people to the city,

sentences.zh: 西德政府抛出了一些激励措施来促使人们搬到那里。

sentences.en: The city was heavily subsidized because it wanted to be attractive.

sentences.en: Food was cheap, rents were really cheap.

sentences.zh: 第二个激励措施是，如果你住在西柏林，

sentences.zh: 就可以免除西德强制性的兵役。
